request: Improve PF IDSW toward CV/EKF on BDD and UA-DETRAC
hypothesis: Frequent resampling and roughening displace the particle-cloud mean from the posterior state just returned to ByteTrack; preserving that mean may stabilize the next predicted box and ID association.
change: Optional PF-only moment-preserving recentering after resampling; default false. Keep particle deviations, weights, ByteTrack association, detector, metric, and other PF settings unchanged.
baseline: PF500-K1K2, motion roughening 2.0, seeds 0/1/2 from R72 and R74
development: UA-DETRAC train dev12, YOLOv8n COCO c25, 25 fps, classes [2,3,5,7], elapsed skip, original R72 cache and GT
confirmation: BDDCOCOVID-val 200 videos, R61 YOLOv8n COCO cache, c25, 5 fps, classes [1,2,3,5,7], buffer 6, elapsed steps, mot_crowd; already observed val, not blind
stages: synthetic invariance and deterministic replay checks
UA smoke on two preselected R72 videos, all three seeds
UA full dev12, all three seeds, only if smoke is valid
BDD three-video smoke and full 200-video three-seed run if UA IDSW decreases and HOTA drops no more than 0.5 percentage points
primary: COMBINED IDSW mean over three seeds, paired within each dataset
guardrails: TrackEval COMBINED HOTA must not decline more than 0.5 percentage points on UA dev12 before BDD full
also report IDF1, DetA, AssA, MOTA, per-seed IDSW, and paired video bootstrap
no claim of convergence to EKF from IDSW alone; compare HOTA and recall
keep old default and thesis benchmark configuration unchanged until evidence is reviewed
